root_cause.text: The gs_usb receive callback anchors the URB before calling usb_submit_urb(), but fails to unanchor it when submission fails, leaving a permanently anchored URB that causes an infinite loop in gs_can_close() when it tries to kill all anchored URBs.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states "the URB was re-anchored before usb_submit_urb() ... However, this patch did not take into account that usb_submit_urb() could fail. The URB remains anchored and usb_kill_anchored_urbs(&parent->rx_submitted) in gs_can_close() loops infinitely since the anchor list never becomes empty." The patch adds "usb_unanchor_urb(urb);" immediately after a failed usb_submit_urb() to fix this.
